title: T043: Phase 3 gate — play suite green + screenshot review
description: Run the full pytest suite and confirm zero failures. Review testscreenshots/play_verified.png against the Play screen checklist: room map visible, HUD shows score + timer, Sally rendered, at least one entity group visible. Phase 3 is not complete until this gate passes. Unblocks Phase 4 (Transition/End/Scoreboard).

title: T042: tests/test_mcp_verify_play.py — MCP roundtrip + screenshot
description: Bridge roundtrip test: jump_to_running → set_level → spawn_powerup → set_invincible → drop_poo → get_state → pixel-sample the HUD area → assert score and timer are visible → save screenshot to testscreenshots/play_verified.png. Follows the same pattern established by test_mcp_verify_start.py.

title: T041: tests/test_play.py — PlayScreen + entity unit tests
description: Headless pytest unit tests covering: click-to-move navigation, Poo cooldown accumulator, obstacle push-out (no stick), NPC patrol/chase state transition, invincibility timer activation and expiry, scoring +1 normal / +5 invincible, per-level countdown timer. Every fixed bug (Bugs #1-#4) must have a dedicated test case that would have caught the original defect.

title: T039: Verify all 5 screen-action MCP tools drive PlayScreen live
description: Smoke-verify that each of the 5 play-screen MCP tools (set_level, spawn_powerup, spawn_npc, drop_poo, set_invincible) correctly drives the running PlayScreen. No new server.py tools needed — this confirms T038 wiring is correct. Prerequisite to Phase 6 full-tool exercise (T102).
close_reason: All 5 tools confirmed registered in server.py and dispatching correctly to PlayScreen — verified by T042 roundtrip tests

title: T038: Wire PlayScreen screen-action MCP poll handlers
description: The MCP server already has 5 screen-action tools registered (T008): set_level, spawn_powerup, spawn_npc, drop_poo, set_invincible. PlayScreen must implement matching handler methods so poll_mcp_command can dispatch to them when PlayScreen is the active screen. Required before MCP-driven tests in T042 can run.

title: T037: Register PlayScreen in App + confirm jump_to_running
description: PlayScreen must be instantiated in app.py and the state machine must route GameState.RUNNING to it. The existing MCP tool jump_to_running (registered in T008) must successfully reach PlayScreen. Confirms the screen is wired into App active-screen switching logic before tests are written.

title: T036: PlayScreen — room map, HUD, scoring, collision wiring
description: The core gameplay screen. Draws the level room map image, renders all entity groups (Player, Poos, Obstacles, NPCs, PowerUps), shows HUD with score and countdown timer, manages the per-level timer, wires all entity collisions, handles cake spawn cadence, and removes the nonsensical MOUSEBUTTONDOWN != UI_BUTTON_PRESSED event guard (Bug #4 fix). All tuning from game/config.py. Covers Stories 3 (scoring) and 7 (timer).

title: T035: PowerUp cake — REAL timer-based invincibility (Bugs #1 & #3 fix)
description: Implements Story 4 (powerup_invincibility) and fixes Bugs #1 and #3. When Sally collects a cake, invincibility is active for INVINCIBLE_SECONDS via a dt-based accumulator — not cosmetic. During invincibility: NPCs cannot catch Sally, Poo drops score +5 instead of +1. Exposes set_invincible(True/False) for the MCP handler wired in T038.

title: T034: NPC entity — random patrol + player-chase AI
description: Implements Story 5 (npc_ai): tenants wander randomly on the map but switch to chase mode when Sally enters NPC_CHASE_RADIUS. A caught Sally (NPC rect overlaps Player rect while not invincible) triggers the END state transition. Must use the directional sprite system so NPCs animate correctly while patrolling and chasing.

title: T033: Obstacle entity — push-out collision, never permanently sticks (Bug #2 fix)
description: Implements Story 6 (obstacles) and fixes Bug #2 (permanent stick). The Obstacle entity defines an immovable furniture rect. When Sally overlaps it, a push-out vector must reposition her to the nearest non-overlapping position each frame rather than zeroing velocity or flagging her as stuck. Prevents the original softlock.

title: T032: Poo entity — spacebar drop with elapsed-time cooldown (Bug #3 fix)
description: Implements Story 2 (pooping) and fixes Bug #3 (no reused repeating timer). Sally drops a Poo sprite at her position when Spacebar is pressed, but only if the cooldown accumulator has elapsed since the last drop. Must use dt-based accumulation instead of pygame.time.set_timer to avoid the original bug where the timer would re-fire unexpectedly.

title: T031: Player entity — click-to-move + directional animation
description: Implements Story 1 (movement): Sally walks toward a clicked point using target-following logic, cycling directional animation frames from the spritesheet. Uses DirectionalSprite base from game/sprites.py. Must handle map boundary clamping and emit the correct hitbox rect for collision detection in PlayScreen.

title: T030: game/entities/__init__.py — exports + shared entity helpers
description: Phase 3 kicks off with the entities package, which is currently empty. This issue establishes the package entry point and any shared helpers (base mixins, sprite group declarations) that Player, Poo, Obstacle, NPC, and PowerUp all rely on. Without this foundation the entity sub-tasks cannot import cleanly.
close_reason: Implemented DIRECTIONS constant, clamp_rect helper, and re-export scaffold
